page.layout: Two columns of text: left margin notes at the left edge; a central column of running text in the left block; a right column of names with years in the right margin; the central column of names runs top to bottom. Left block: running text with side notes in the left margin. Right block: list of names with dates at the right margin.

main_text.p: Rursum plebs commota Gron-ingæ. Et bellum refusci-tatum in diæcesi Vltraiect.
Edsardus Com. moritur. Pax composita inter Caro-lum v Cæs. & Carolum Geldr.
Simultas inter Groninga-nos & Emdanos orta de por-torio Emdano.
Ifćna obsessa ab Ennone Com. Edsardi F. eiq; dedita cum Balthasare.
Maria Icverana autore Bo-lingo Oldersh. ab Ennone descit.
Balthasar Efensis neglecto iureiurando in fidem Caroli Geldri se confert, & bellum Ennoni movet.
-Geldri, & Balthasar Efensis bellum compositum reno-vant in Frisia Orient.

page.notes: The page is a list of magistrates, with years 1527, 1528, 1529, 1530, 1531, 1532, 1533 in the right margin. Lines are grouped by year, separated by rules. Some year numerals are faint or partly obscured. The year numerals were not part of the main text; they are only in the margin. Left-column entries are printed as narrative items, with some words uncertain (e.g. "Ifćna", "Icverana", "Oldersh") due to the handwritten-style and damaged type.
